note: Draft numbers, to be balanced by mass tests. Texts live in language files, not here.

generator.note: Draft numbers for the player generator, to be balanced with the distribution report.

zones.note: Pitch as 5 columns (own goal to opponent goal) x 5 lanes (left wing, left half-space, centre, right half-space, right wing), seen from the team on the ball. Engine 2, steps 10a and 10d2.

chance_spot.note: Where a chance from open play comes from: edge of the box, box, six-yard box. The spot sets the quality of the chance (half, chance, big).

actions.note: What the player on the ball does in a zone (engine 2, step 10b). weights per column 0..4, lanes left/centre/right.

counter.note: A ball won in these columns (seen from the team that lost it) can start a counter attack from the mirrored column.

character.note: Hidden character traits in the match (engine 2, step 10c). A trait counts as (value - reference) / scale, from -1 to 1.

added_time.note: Stoppage time per half (IFAB Law 7): from what happened in the half. Bundesliga recently about 10 minutes per match. Per-minute rates of the match are scaled by minutes / (minutes + expected), so the longer clock does not add goals.

time_wasting.note: Delays punished by the Laws: keeper holds the ball over 8 seconds (corner, IFAB 2025/26), five-second countdown at throw-in and goal kick (IFAB 2026/27). Chance per minute for a leading team from the minute on.

career.note: Document 16. Levels: - low, 0 middle, + high, ++ very high. All numbers are drafts for the mass tests.
